decisions.reason: 技能折扣 denotes reduced Skill learning cost; giảm giá Skill is overly literal and unnatural in Vietnamese gameplay text.
decisions.terminology_basis: 速度 → Speed; 智力 → Wit; 因子 → Spark; 技能 → Skill; existing Skill-name rendering is preserved.
